decision_record.mechanism: refuse call debit spread entries when the short leg's (ask-bid)/mid > 0.50; entry debit is priced off the short bid while exit value is priced off its ask, and only the long leg carried a liquidity gate
decision_record.transfer: counterparties paying for immediacy/reversion on a live print keep the surplus only while the print is live; a stale print transfers the sleeve's capital to whoever holds the live side
